empty: No inputs — the effect takes everything from the sheets.

each.name: Each
each.label: Each
each.hint: what one sheet from the list is called in the steps after “For each of”

ask.actor: , if not given — ask the player
ask.gm: , if not given — ask the game master

record.label: Record type
record.hint: the effect receives the item whose button was pressed and reads its properties by the input name

who.label: Who is it
who.hint: who to put here if no sheet is passed
who.target: target — the one chosen at the table or the current one

missing.label: If not passed
missing.title: “required” — the system check will not let it pass without it; “default” — the given value is used; “may be empty” — the input is optional; or ask at the table

hint.label: Hint at the table
hint.hint: what the asked person will see

measure.label: Fill in with distance to the target
measure.hint: the asked person is shown the distance to each target; the row whose bounds contain it is picked
measure.aria: “{{name}}” — fill in with distance to the target

amount.label: Amount
amount.hint: hanging effects can modify this number — by the stages you declare. One per effect

bounds.label: Bounds
bounds.hint: not lower and not higher — a number or a formula, for example luck

keyHint.param: what the input is called in formulas. It follows the name until someone refers to it
keyHint.result: what the result is called for the caller. It follows the name until someone refers to it

no.label: Name of “no”
no.hint: label of the second branch: “miss”, “did not save”
